## Activity

During April 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 442 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance at the site.

## Image quality

Of the 442 captures, 10 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.3%. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine operational review. Any recurring issues identified during review can be addressed through local support and feedback.

## Grading

Grading identified 97 referable results during April 2023. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides an overall measure of turnaround for the reporting period and should be considered alongside the capture volume and image-quality findings. Overall, the site maintained planned activity, with grading completed within the recorded median lag and image quality assessed for the full set of captures.
